## Notes

- Media is encrypted in transit end to end between participants and Coriander's media servers; Coriander keeps connection logs (IP address, room ID, timestamps) for 30 days for troubleshooting.
- Coriander's adaptive bitrate supports down to 300 kbps video, with audio-only below that.
- Breach notification: within 72 hours of discovery to the Privacy Officer.
- Interpreter and caregiver guests join through the same SDK, so three-way calls do not need a second vendor.
- Coriander is a subprocessor-style dependency, not a clinical system on its own; the clinical system in the inventory is the platform built on top of it.
